=== WebAssembly Workshop @ POPL 2027 ===

Website: https://popl27.sigplan.org/home/waw-2027

WebAssembly is a general-purpose low-level virtual machine, adopted by all major Web browsers and specified fully in terms of a pen-and-paper formal semantics. The WebAssembly Workshop (WAW) at POPL 2027 aims to bring together researchers, standards body members, and industry practitioners, in order to continue and foster a growing trend of academic contributions to the WebAssembly ecosystem spanning verification, security, and programming language analysis and theory.

We enthusiastically request WebAssembly-related abstract submissions, including prior, ongoing, and early-stage work, for presentation and discussion at the workshop.

Call for presentations URL:
https://popl27.sigplan.org/home/waw-2027#call-Call-for-Presentations

Submission deadline: Tuesday 3rd November 2026 (EOD AOE)

Best wishes
Conrad Watt
